title: Hoy by Dominik Kandravý: sleek Apple-style glass UI with morphing motion
note: Lydia likes the sleek Apple feel, the glassmorphism, the dotted-grid vibe, and the smooth morphing animation. Hoy is a menu-bar app for Mac, iPhone and iPad that puts your people one tap away: hold a face to talk, drop files, share screen, FaceTime. Site: https://gethoy.app/
